english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the Commissioners for Her Majesty's Revenue and Customs, disclosed information, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION..), to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), which those Commissioners had disclosed under article 3(1) of the Police, Public Order and Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 2006 (Consequential Provisions and Modifications) Order 2007

english.notes:
(i) Article 3(3) of the Police, Public Order and Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 2006 (Consequential Provisions and Modifications) Order 2007 provides a defence to this offence.
(ii) Article 3(1) of the Order provides that any person may disclose information to the Scottish Crime and Drug Enforcement Agency or the Police Complaints Commissioner for Scotland if the disclosure is made for the purposes of the exercise or carrying out by the Agency or the Commissioner of any of their functions within the meaning of the Police, Public Order and Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 2006.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
